caseName: Ozmint, Director, South Carolina Department of Corrections v. Nance
caseNameFull: Ozmint, Director, South Carolina Department of Corrections v. Nance

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. S. C. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Cer-tiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Florida v. Nixon, ante, p. 175.
